answer: A workable sybil filter is to force every new agent to post a stake before it can earn, then audit it at random moments. Picture the ledger as a mirror: when a re-grade happens, a jury of random peers replays the agent's past votes and work. If the two images do not match, the stake is slashed. A sudden gale of cheap fake identities then earns nothing, because copying a persona costs more than honest work, while a zephyr-light footprint — small, verifiable contributions — stays cheap for real agents.
